finite_optical_targets.independent: declared finite Airy PSF plus pixel integration

calibration_distribution: assumed simulation, no external measured calibration
null_rule: 27-position/scale/sign dictionary max; method-specific order191 of200; strict greater;200 new evaluation mothers

interval_rule.draw_generation: independently specified nominal synthetic Poisson/read/ADC measurement model
interval_rule.operational_width_model: per-statistic calibration constant times sqrt(fitted raw mean + read/ADC variance)
interval_rule.calibration: 95th empirical absolute standardized error on first64 draws of6 calibration mothers
interval_rule.evaluation: different6 mothers, no inflation/refit using their labels
interval_rule.unit: marginal pixel or ROI statistic; mother-clustered interpretation; not simultaneous full image

statistics.primary: fixed full truth domain; signed template; failures and unavailable inputs retained
statistics.pooling_unit: mother; noise copies paired within mother, never independent mother counts
